cover: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium editorial abstract still-life illustration for the cover of a research presentation about sensor model compression. Portrait-ish 4:5 image. A flowing teal ribbon formed from many very fine parallel translucent strands, gradually gathering into a smooth compact curved loop. Warm ivory background #F6F4EE, desaturated teal #287D78, deep green-black shadows, tiny restrained muted terracotta highlight. Soft directional natural studio light, tactile frosted glass/satin material, elegant quiet spatial depth. Object occupies center-right with breathing space, no complex machinery. Conceptual artwork only, not a measurement or a factual depiction of a sensor. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, icons, chart axes, UI, watermark, border. Sophisticated understated research editorial atmosphere, not glossy corporate stock art.
